description: The baum tile kit, version 1: the API, elements, classes and tokens a custom tile may use. Frozen and additive only: names are added, never removed, renamed or changed in meaning.

api.name: baum.tile
api.description: Registers the tile's two render functions; call it exactly once. Each is called with a view and may return a Node (or text, or an array of them), append to view.root itself, or return a Promise that settles within 3 seconds. It is called again with a fresh root when the data changes.

api.name: baum.html
api.description: An escaping tagged template. Interpolated values become text, nodes or the items of an array (null, undefined and booleans draw nothing); in an attribute they are set as its value. It throws, for static parts and values alike, on: on* attributes; an a, area or SVG use href that is not a #fragment; any other URL attribute (src, poster, an SVG image href and the like) that is not a data:image/... or blob: URL; a style value holding ; : { } ( ) quotes, a backslash, /* or url (set data-driven sizes as custom properties: style="--value:${n}"); values inside style, script, title or textarea elements, comments, tag or attribute names, or a template; and the elements script, iframe, frame, object, embed, form, base, meta and link. Data is never parsed as HTML.

api.name: baum.cite
api.description: A <baum-cite> chip for a citation in the data, labelled from what the page resolved (a file and line for a hunk) or with label. In a glance it is plain text; in a detail a navigable citation is a button that jumps there. An unresolved citation draws a dashed "Citation unavailable" chip and is reported by the render check.

api.name: baum.diff
api.description: A <baum-diff> for a hunk citation. A glance draws the file, range and +added −removed on one line. A detail draws the excerpt the page sent: a header that jumps to the code, up to maxLines (default 40) numbered lines with a "Show N more lines" toggle; long lines wrap, as the review's excerpts do. Without an excerpt it says "Diff unavailable" and why.

api.name: baum.md
api.description: A <baum-md> drawing a small Markdown subset as the review does: paragraphs and line breaks, **strong**, *emphasis*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code`, fenced code, lists, ### and #### headings, quotes and rules. Raw HTML stays text; a link is its words with the URL as a tooltip. inline draws one line of words with the block marks dropped.

api.name: baum.compare
api.signature: baum.compare(was: string, now: string): { was: HTMLElement, now: HTMLElement, same: boolean }
api.description: A before and an after compared word by word, as the review's columns compare them: was and now are spans of the text, the runs of words the other lacks in <del class="kit-del"> and <ins class="kit-ins">. Texts that share under half their words are left unmarked (rewritten, not edited). same is true when the two have the same words, whatever their spacing; case counts.

api.name: baum.empty
api.description: The standard empty state, for data with nothing to show. The render check counts it as content.

api.name: baum.fail
api.description: The standard error state, for data the tile cannot draw. It reports render_failed to the page; return or append the element it gives.

api.name: baum.refs.get
api.description: What the page resolved for a citation in the data, or null: {status: "ok", label, navigable, ...fields of its kind} or {status: "unavailable", label, why}.

api.name: baum.jump
api.description: Asks the page to go to a citation, as a cite chip does. Honoured only while the reader is in the tile and only for a citation the page resolved for it as navigable; returns false when it is not.

api.name: baum.ask
api.description: Asks the page to open the chat about this tile. Honoured only while the reader is in the tile.

api.name: baum.openDetail
api.description: Asks the page to open this tile's detail. Honoured only while the reader is in the tile.

view.name: data
view.description: The tile's own data, already valid against its data schema.

view.name: size
view.description: The layout size, "full", "half" or "third". Advisory: lay out by the frame's width.

view.name: theme
view.description: The app's theme when the render started, "light" or "dark". Colour through tokens and it follows changes by itself.

view.name: root
view.description: The element to draw into, empty and fresh on every render.

attributes.name: data-kind
attributes.description: The citation's type: hunk, file, commit, risk, evidence, change, tile, check, review_thread and the other anchor types.

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Whether the citation resolved.

attributes.name: data-face
attributes.description: One line in a glance, the lines in a detail.

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Whether there is code to show.

elements.name: baum-md
elements.description: Markdown, as the review draws it.

attributes.name: data-inline
attributes.description: Present for baum.md(text, {inline: true}).

classes.name: kit-stack
classes.description: Children in a column, 12px apart.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The gap in --space-N steps (0 for none).

classes.name: kit-row
classes.description: Children in a wrapping row, centred, 8px apart.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The gap in --space-N steps.

attributes.name: data-wrap
attributes.description: Keeps the row on one line.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Aligns children to the top or the text baseline.

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: Pushes the first and last children to the ends.

classes.name: kit-grow
classes.description: A row child that takes the remaining width and may shrink.

classes.name: kit-natural
classes.description: A row child that keeps its natural size (flex: none) while others grow or shrink.

classes.name: kit-grid
classes.description: Cards in as many columns of at least 14rem as fit.

classes.name: kit-columns
classes.description: Children in equal columns; the count comes from data as a custom property.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: --columns: the number of columns, set from a number: style="--columns:${n}" (2 by default).

classes.name: kit-bar
classes.description: A thin bar filled in proportion to a value from data, as a meter beside a number.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: --value: a number from 0 to 1, set as style="--value:${share}".

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The fill's status colour; the first chart colour without one.

classes.name: kit-scroll
classes.description: A box that scrolls sideways when its content (a wide table) is wider than the frame.

classes.name: kit-glance
classes.description: A glance's layout: a full-height column whose kit-foot keeps to the bottom.

classes.name: kit-foot
classes.description: Small, quiet facts at the foot of a glance, one per child, kept apart by middle dots.

classes.name: kit-section
classes.description: A part of a detail: a heading (a kit-heading h2) over its content; sections are spaced apart.

classes.name: kit-card
classes.description: A bordered, rounded box, such as one per table or endpoint.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: Tints the border with a status.

classes.name: kit-list
classes.description: An unbulleted list of rows, 8px apart; each li is a row.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The gap in --space-N steps.

attributes.name: data-divided
attributes.description: Rules between the rows.

classes.name: kit-bullets
classes.description: A bulleted (ul) or numbered (ol) list of prose, as in Markdown.

classes.name: kit-title
classes.description: A title inside a detail: 18px, heading face.

classes.name: kit-lede
classes.description: The glance's lead line: the answer to "do I need to open this?".

classes.name: kit-count
classes.description: A headline number: 28px, heading face, tabular figures.

classes.name: kit-muted
classes.description: Secondary text.

classes.name: kit-subtle
classes.description: Tertiary text: captions, meta, counts beside a label.

classes.name: kit-small
classes.description: Small print (13px).

classes.name: kit-strong
classes.description: Semibold text.

classes.name: kit-heading
classes.description: A section heading in a detail, as the review's parts draw theirs: 16px, semibold, tracked, uppercase; a kit-section rules it off.

classes.name: kit-kicker
classes.description: An uppercase section label: 13px, weight 500, tracked, tertiary.

classes.name: kit-mono
classes.description: Code face: paths, identifiers, types.

classes.name: kit-num
classes.description: Tabular figures; right-aligned in a kit-table cell.

classes.name: kit-break
classes.description: Lets a long path or token break anywhere rather than overflow.

classes.name: kit-truncate
classes.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis.

classes.name: kit-clamp-1
classes.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis.

classes.name: kit-clamp-2
classes.description: At most two lines, cut with an ellipsis.

classes.name: kit-clamp-3
classes.description: At most three lines, cut with an ellipsis.

classes.name: kit-added
classes.description: The colour of added lines (+3).

classes.name: kit-removed
classes.description: The colour of removed lines (−1).

classes.name: kit-ins
classes.description: Words an after adds, tinted (baum.compare makes them).

classes.name: kit-del
classes.description: Words a before loses, tinted and struck (baum.compare makes them).

classes.name: kit-sep
classes.description: A middle dot between inline facts.

classes.name: kit-badge
classes.description: A status pill. Status tones only for status, never for a category.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The status; neutral without one.

classes.name: kit-pill
classes.description: A solid pill marking what a change is, as the review's diagrams do: New (info), Changed (caution), Removed or Breaking (critical).

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The status; neutral without one.

classes.name: kit-tag
classes.description: A boxed tag for a category, a kind or a method; add kit-mono for code.

classes.name: kit-dot
classes.description: An 8px dot before a row: a risk tier or a status.

attributes.name: data-tier
attributes.description: A risk tier's colour.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: A status colour.

classes.name: kit-callout
classes.description: A tinted note in the flow of a detail.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The status it reports; a faint wash without one.

classes.name: kit-tone
classes.description: Text in the colour of its data-tone.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: The status colour.

classes.name: kit-facts
classes.description: A dl of label and value pairs in two columns.

classes.name: kit-table
classes.description: A table of rows: quiet small headings, ruled rows.

attributes.name: data-tone
attributes.description: On a tr: tints an added (positive), changed (caution) or removed (critical) row.

classes.name: kit-details
classes.description: A details/summary disclosure styled as the review's.

classes.name: kit-switch
classes.description: A switch: a <label> around an <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> and its words, drawn as the app's toggles. Listen for change with addEventListener.

classes.name: kit-empty
classes.description: The empty state baum.empty draws.

classes.name: kit-fail
classes.description: The error state baum.fail draws.

tokens.description: A recessed fill, as chips use.

tokens.name: --surface-wash
tokens.description: A faint static fill, such as a header strip.

tokens.name: --status-caution
